# JOHIA Creatives

> The official interactive recruitment and onboarding web experience for JOHIA Creatives at Jesus Our Hope International Assemblies - Cubao.

## Overview
JOHIA Creatives shapes the visual atmosphere, storytelling, and digital communication of Jesus Our Hope International Assemblies - Cubao. We are a community of disciples using creativity, media, photography, and design to amplify the message of hope in Jesus Christ.

## Structure & Creative Branches
- **Branch 01: Photography** - High-resolution stage worship capture, candid moments, macro instrument details, and Sunday photo documentation.
- **Branch 02: Graphic Design** - Sermon series key visuals, LED sanctuary backdrops, announcement graphics, and print/digital collateral.
- **Branch 03: Write-Ups & Editorial** - Devotional captions, sermon recaps, ministry storytelling, and authentic faith-building communications.
- **Branch 04: Social Media & Distribution** - Multi-slide Instagram/Facebook carousels, event coverage, community engagement, and digital outreach.

## Service Coordinates
- **Gathering Time:** Sundays at 10:00 AM (In-Person & Live Stream)
- **Location:** #15 Cambridge St., Cubao, Quezon City, Metro Manila, Philippines
- **Official Facebook:** https://www.facebook.com/johiacubaoph
- **Join / Volunteer Application:** https://forms.gle/AXmj7uZFNKisdVfK6
